column1: # ZAP baseline rules for the sample report served by 'python -m http.server' in zap.yml.
# The real report is a local HTML file: no web server sends its headers, and its CSP is set in a <meta> tag
# (default-src 'none', nonce-only script/style). Header-only protections cannot be expressed there.

column3: (Missing Anti-clickjacking Header: needs a response header or frame-ancestors, which browsers ignore in <meta> CSP)
(X-Content-Type-Options Header Missing: response header from the throwaway test server)
(Information Disclosure - Suspicious Comments: words in the report's own filter script)
(Server Leaks Version Information: Python http.server banner, test harness only)
(CSP Header Not Set: the report sets its CSP via <meta http-equiv>)
(CSP: no fallback directive: frame-ancestors is not allowed in a <meta> CSP)
(Private IP Disclosure: the sample tenant's named-location ranges, which are report content)
(Storable and Cacheable Content: caching headers of the throwaway test server; the report is a local file)
(Permissions Policy Header Not Set: response header only; cannot be set from a local file)
(Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy Header Missing: response header only; the report loads no cross-origin resources)
